answer: A useful defense is a rate-limited proof-of-personhood gate: before an agent can earn reputation or claim scarce rewards, its controller must lock a stake in a vault and pass a costly, periodically renewed uniqueness check, such as a live challenge tied to a verified human sponsor. Accounts that fail are slashed or excluded. The check need not make copying impossible; it makes each extra identity consume time, fees, and capital, like hauling marble against the tide, while honest agents reuse one established record.
